class.name: UZUTiltShift
class.brief_description: Tilt-shift band blur for the U.ZU look, as a compositor effect.
class.description: Keeps a horizontal band of the screen sharp and blurs the parts above and below it, more the farther they are from the band, like a tilt-shift lens. Scenes then read as miniature dioramas, the core of the "HD-2D" look. Add it to a [Compositor] used by a [WorldEnvironment] or a [Camera3D]. The blur radius of a row is [code]max_blur * smoothstep(0, 1, (|y - focus_center| - focus_width) / transition)[/code], in pixels at 1080 lines and scaled with the screen height ([method get_blur_radius_at] returns it). [b]Note:[/b] Runs only on RenderingDevice renderers (Forward+ and Mobile) with a 16-bit float color buffer. It does nothing in the Compatibility renderer. [b]Note:[/b] This class is specific to U.ZU Engine.

method.name: get_blur_radius_at
method.description: Returns the blur radius in pixels at [param screen_y] (a fraction of the screen height, 0 at the top and 1 at the bottom) on a screen of [param screen_height] lines. The effect's shader uses the same formula, so agents and tests can check the band without rendering.

members.member: The middle of the sharp band, as a fraction of the screen height from the top.
Half the height of the sharp band, as a fraction of the screen height.
The blur radius in pixels (at 1080 lines) far from the band. 0 turns the effect off.
The distance from the band (a fraction of the screen height) over which the blur grows from none to [member max_blur].
